profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at WGU
profile.summary:
I enjoy organizing and leading teams to accomplish rewarding tasks. From leading a Tough Mudder team to a scalability analysis group for an online class registration web app.

I love mental and physical challenges. I enjoy all-night code burst as much as a half-marathon. I take pride in solving issues in the most efficient route instead of the most overdesigned dissertation-worthy path.

I have a soft spot for animals. In a previous life, I likely was a veterinarian. I look forward to the weekends where my SPCA's Hounds around Towns certification allows me to take a shelter dog for a day of hiking in the beautiful Salt Lake City' mountain ridges.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Team Lead
positions.description:
•	Led the testing workstream for the ASA/VSA modernization initiative, directing 5 DXC contractors in establishing JUnit and API test coverage where little previously existed; this resulted in more stable code and higher deployment confidence.
•	Coached junior developers in the verification of AI-generated code so that test assertions are thorough, not superficial.
•	Coordinated ASA/VSA deployment, UI testing, and eventual system handoff with the Academic Delivery Tech organization.
•	Led the Scrum Alliance Certification automation initiative from stakeholder discovery through delivery, gathering requirements directly from end users, coordinating team responsibilities, and automating previously manual data-gathering and email processes.
•	Spearheaded the IdMapping security initiative on a team of 7 to replace predictable sequential student ID with GUID-based mappings to protect personally identifiable information. 
•	Convinced the principal architect that sharing a common IdMap table across the 5 apps resulted in higher performance and maintainability.
•	Led the IdMapping REST endpoint through proof of concept, architecture review, business approval, testing, and production deployment.
•	Analyzed Student Portal performance and designed StudentEngagement REST endpoints that moved filtering and sorting work out of the Angular client; used Dynatrace analysis to identify race conditions and resolved them through idempotent REST behavior.
•	Organized inter- and intra-team technical design discussions and coordinated creation of load testing for the Academy application, which previously lacked load-test coverage.
•	Upgraded the Kotlin-based Open Skills Management Tool Set and developed Diamond Skills, an internal Angular/REST application built on the OSMT library.
•	Mentored junior Java developers and provided technical guidance to engineers encountering unfamiliar technologies or implementation problems.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Docker · Elasticsearch · Spring Boot · Oracle Database

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Rancho Cordova, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Senior developer of Claims team; this team manages the handling of the most import payload of VSP which is daily claim processing.
Implemented a SpringBoot micro services driven solution to replace the 17 years old WebSphere (JDK 1.6) monolith based on Soap and Main Frame ECI calls
Migrated camel route Rest app on JBoss to SpringBoot service on Tomcat.
Converted Windows scheduled batch applications to SpringBatch that ran on Linux.
Mentor junior developers into TDD, Clean Code principles and leveraging JDK8 improvements ie streams, lambdas, optionals.
Leveraged Jenkins to expedite building and deployment of critical apps.
Introduced VSP to incorporating H2 DB for Rest service component testing.
Created Test Harness framework to JUnit test all 1200+ drool rules; previously there were no JUnits.

positions.title: Senior Ruby Developer
positions.description: Created RESTful Ruby libraries/gems to expose internal resources to Streamsend's privileged customers

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Contract
positions.description:
Implemented JBoss’s open-source Drools Rule Engine into the Counsel Link Web Application. 
Created Wicket based web pages that leveraged Ajax to ensure a user friendly interface.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Converted Java/JSP based applications to utilize Spring technology.
Wrote C++ apps that imported data from a legacy Clipper DB or flat files to Oracle.
Created Perl scripts to simplify the parsing of application log files.
Prototyped demo web apps via LAMP (Linux, Apache, Mysql, PHP) technology.
